scripts.dev: docker compose -f docker/dev/docker-compose.yml up --build -d && docker compose -f docker/dev/docker-compose.yml logs -f api worker web
scripts.dev:logs: docker compose -f docker/dev/docker-compose.yml logs -f api worker web
scripts.dev:restart: docker compose -f docker/dev/docker-compose.yml restart api worker web
scripts.prod:logs: docker compose -f docker/prod/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env.production logs -f api worker web
scripts.prod:migrate: docker compose -f docker/prod/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env.production run --rm --no-deps api sh -c 'cd apps/api && pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy'
scripts.db:seed:dev: docker compose -f docker/dev/docker-compose.yml exec api sh -c 'cd apps/api && pnpm exec prisma db seed'
scripts.test:all: pnpm test:api && pnpm test:worker && pnpm test:web
scripts.ci:check: pnpm lint && pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter worker build && pnpm --filter web build && pnpm test:all
